result: The "rank of that response time among all alerts" refers to ranking all records that meet the criteria for being considered an alert. SELECT 
    rectrace,
    resptime,
    loadscore,
    perfscore,
    perfscore - loadscore AS performance_delta,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY resptime DESC) AS resptime_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN resptime > 200 THEN 'Critical'
        WHEN resptime > 150 THEN 'Warning'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS category
FROM systemperformance
WHERE resptime > 100
ORDER BY resptime DESC
LIMIT 10;
